resources.title: 2.2. Concepts
resources.purpose: Grounds the table/row/column relational vocabulary Day 19 needs before mapping an entity to a table and a field to a column.

resources.title: 5.5. Constraints (Primary Keys, Foreign Keys)
resources.purpose: Grounds PRIMARY KEY and FOREIGN KEY semantics for Day 19's entity mapping foundation and Day 32's direct ERD/schema relationship design.

resources.title: 7.2.1.1. Joined Tables
resources.purpose: Grounds INNER JOIN and LEFT OUTER JOIN row-matching semantics for Day 20's SQL foundation and Day 32's relationship-aware query refinement.

resources.title: 2.5. Querying a Table
resources.purpose: Grounds SELECT/WHERE query semantics for Day 20 and Day 32's direct query-filtering refinement; the Joined Tables source assumes this foundation.

resources.title: 3.4. Transactions
resources.purpose: Grounds the transaction boundary, atomicity/durability, and BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK semantics Day 20 needs before introducing @Transactional.

resources.title: 13.2. Transaction Isolation
resources.purpose: Grounds isolation levels and the anomalies they prevent (dirty/nonrepeatable/phantom read) for Day 20's basic isolation mental model, deepened at Day 32.

resources.title: 13.3. Explicit Locking
resources.purpose: Grounds basic locking/concurrency-control reasoning for Day 20, deepened at Day 32's concurrency tradeoff discussion.

resources.title: 11.1. Introduction
resources.purpose: Grounds the basic index mental model (lookup vs. sequential scan) Day 20 needs before Day 24's performance content, deepened at Day 32.

resources.title: Architecture
resources.purpose: Grounds SecurityFilterChain/FilterChainProxy/HttpSecurity as the canonical Java-config mechanism for Day 22's authentication filter chain and Day 33's capstone security config, replacing the deprecated WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter pattern the lesson already warns against.

resources.title: Servlet Authentication Architecture
resources.purpose: Grounds AuthenticationManager/ProviderManager/AuthenticationProvider and the credentials-to-Authentication flow Day 33 needs before the capstone can authenticate a login request prior to issuing a JWT.

resources.title: DaoAuthenticationProvider
resources.purpose: Grounds exactly how DaoAuthenticationProvider validates a username/password pair via UserDetailsService and PasswordEncoder before AuthenticationManager returns a successful Authentication, completing Day 33's login-to-JWT-issuance chain.

resources.title: Authorize HttpServletRequests
resources.purpose: Grounds the authorizeHttpRequests DSL (permitAll/authenticated/hasRole, AuthorizationFilter, deny-by-default ordering) Day 22 relies on for its public-vs-protected route rules and Day 33 reuses for the capstone's own endpoint authorization.

resources.title: JwtEncoder (Interface)
resources.purpose: The decisive JWT-issuance API: establishes the framework contract for signing/encrypting a JWT to its compact representation, grounding Day 33's self-issued token generation without custom crypto.

resources.title: NimbusJwtEncoder
resources.purpose: Grounds the concrete, framework-managed JwtEncoder implementation Day 33 issues tokens with — signing is delegated to a JWKSource-supplied key (symmetric or asymmetric), never hand-rolled.

resources.title: JwtClaimsSet
resources.purpose: Grounds the standard registered claims (subject, expiresAt, issuedAt, issuer) Day 33 must set when building the JwtEncoderParameters passed to JwtEncoder.encode().

resources.title: ExceptionTranslationFilter
resources.purpose: Grounds the exact routing rule Day 22 needs for 401 vs 403: an AuthenticationException always reaches AuthenticationEntryPoint, while an AccessDeniedException reaches AccessDeniedHandler only for an already-authenticated (non-anonymous) user.

resources.title: AuthenticationEntryPoint (Interface)
resources.purpose: Grounds the exact 401/challenge mechanism (commence()) Day 22 cites for AuthenticationEntryPoint, the collaborator ExceptionTranslationFilter delegates to on authentication failure.

resources.title: AccessDeniedHandler (Interface)
resources.purpose: Grounds the exact 403/access-denied mechanism (handle()) Day 22 cites for AccessDeniedHandler, the collaborator ExceptionTranslationFilter delegates to for an authenticated-but-unauthorized user.
